title: Single odd reading
note: One odd body-temperature reading (a sensor glitch or typo that still passes the input check) on one day of an ordinary Mars transit stretch. Nothing is wrong with the crewmember, so every alert is a false alert. Every value is a demo parameter chosen by the team, not a medical reference. The expectations below were written before the first run, but committed together with the results (unlike fever.json, which was committed first). If any value is changed after seeing results, say so on the project page.
expected: Earth range only: amber on most days, because the in-flight base of 37.4 °C sits above the Earth upper limit. All of these are false alerts.
Adjusted range: no false alerts. The odd reading (about 37.9 °C) is still inside the adjusted range.
Adjusted range and baseline: no false alerts. The odd reading is outside the personal baseline, but it is one reading, not three in a row.
No method turns red, because the odd reading stays below the critical limit.
